**WAKE CC** — ALEX RULING (2026-07-29), acknowledged as a LOOP DEFECT, not new input: Alex should not have to say a thing twice, and CC must not need telling each time.

FILED as BEB-2436 §6.5 (THE GATE IS CODE, NOT A MESSAGE):
(6.5) the binding probe runs as a PRE-REFINE HARD GATE inside the dispatcher — not a Fable directive, not a ticket comment, not a per-incident correction. A lane entering refine without a passed probe is a dispatcher defect. Proof it belongs in code: the ruling landed at m8495 and 2429 (m8491) + 2432 (m8497) blocked on the SAME invented repos minutes later, because the correction lived in prose.
(6.5.1) a red carrying a KNOWN fix EXECUTES ON DETECTION — no wake, no question, no repeat instruction. Known fix unapplied = the loop idle by choice.
(6.5.2) Alex restating a standing order is logged as a loop failure in the ZERO_CLAIM class. The response to a repeat is to find why the first statement never reached the gate and close that path — never to apply the fix once more by hand.
(6.5.3) acceptance F: replay a dead-repo ticket with NO human in the path — BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE fires, refine never starts, correct binding applied from the ticket's own repo field. A recovery that needs a directive is a FAIL.

CC ACTIONS NOW, no confirmation needed: (1) requeue 2428/2429/2432 — bindings already corrected in-ticket to alexrollin/abilifi-apps ticket branches + orky-beb-<n> workers.dev; (2) wire the pre-refine binding probe into the dispatcher and land acceptance F; (3) stop reporting a known-fix red as status — apply it and report the landing.
